audio.t: Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen. This is your captain speaking. We've just been informed that there's heavy traffic at Frankfurt airport, so we'll be holding on the ground here for about twenty minutes before takeoff. I apologize for the delay. We expect to make up some of the time in the air, so our arrival should be only about ten minutes later than scheduled. Passengers with connecting flights in Frankfurt should have enough time, but ground staff will be available at the gate to assist you.

questions.prompt: Who most likely is the speaker?
questions.evidence: This is your captain speaking.
questions.explanation: « Your captain » : c'est le commandant de bord, le pilote.

questions.prompt: What is causing the delay?
questions.evidence: there's heavy traffic at Frankfurt airport
questions.explanation: Le trafic est dense à l'aéroport de Francfort, la destination.
questions.takeaway: Hold on the ground = attendre au sol.

questions.prompt: What does the speaker suggest about the arrival time?
options: The flight will arrive on time.
The delay will be shorter than the wait on the ground.
The flight will land at a different airport.
questions.evidence: our arrival should be only about ten minutes later than scheduled
questions.explanation: On attend 20 minutes au sol, mais l'arrivée n'aura que 10 minutes de retard : on rattrapera du temps en vol.
questions.takeaway: Make up time = rattraper du temps.

audio.t: Tired of spending your evenings on invoices and receipts? LedgerLite is the accounting software designed for freelancers and small shops. Just take a photo of a receipt with your phone, and LedgerLite records the expense automatically. At the end of each quarter, it prepares a tax summary you can send directly to your accountant. Try it free for sixty days, no credit card required. And if you switch from another software before June, we'll transfer all your data for you at no cost.

questions.prompt: Who is the advertisement mainly intended for?
questions.evidence: designed for freelancers and small shops
questions.explanation: Le logiciel vise les indépendants et les petits commerces.

questions.prompt: What does the software do with photos of receipts?
questions.evidence: LedgerLite records the expense automatically
questions.explanation: La photo d'un reçu suffit pour enregistrer automatiquement la dépense.

questions.prompt: What is offered to customers who switch before June?
options: A discount on the first year
questions.evidence: we'll transfer all your data for you at no cost
questions.explanation: Le transfert des données est gratuit pour ceux qui changent avant juin.

audio.t: I have some great news. We've signed a three-year contract with Halvorsen Hotels to manage the marketing for their twelve properties in Scandinavia. This is our largest account ever. Now, I realize we're already busy with the spring campaigns. That's why we'll hire two additional designers next month, and Mark will lead the Halvorsen team. Mark, I'd like you to set up a kickoff meeting with their marketing director before the end of next week.

questions.prompt: What is the main topic of the talk?
questions.evidence: We've signed a three-year contract with Halvorsen Hotels
questions.explanation: L'entreprise a signé un contrat de trois ans avec une chaîne d'hôtels.

questions.prompt: Why does the speaker say, "I realize we're already busy with the spring campaigns"?
options: To acknowledge a concern about workload
questions.evidence: I realize we're already busy with the spring campaigns.
questions.explanation: Elle reconnaît que l'équipe est déjà chargée, puis annonce deux recrutements pour y répondre.
questions.takeaway: « That's why » montre que la phrase précédente posait un problème.

questions.prompt: What is Mark asked to do?
options: Organize a first meeting with the client
questions.evidence: set up a kickoff meeting with their marketing director
questions.explanation: Mark doit organiser une réunion de lancement avec la directrice marketing du client.

audio.t: Hello, Ms. Osei. This is Roland Petit from the human resources department at Vireo Labs. Thank you for interviewing with us on Tuesday. The team was very impressed with your experience in clinical research. Before we can make a final decision, we'd like you to complete a short written exercise, which should take about two hours. I'll send it to you by e-mail this afternoon. Please return it by Monday morning, and feel free to call me if you have any questions.

questions.prompt: Why is the speaker calling?
options: To follow up on a job interview
questions.evidence: Thank you for interviewing with us on Tuesday.
questions.explanation: Il fait suite à l'entretien d'embauche de mardi.
questions.takeaway: Interview with = passer un entretien chez.

questions.prompt: What is the listener asked to do?
questions.evidence: we'd like you to complete a short written exercise
questions.explanation: Elle doit réaliser un court exercice écrit avant la décision finale.

questions.prompt: When must the listener return the exercise?
questions.evidence: Please return it by Monday morning
questions.explanation: Elle doit le rendre lundi matin au plus tard.
questions.traps: Deux heures est la durée estimée de l'exercice, pas le délai.

audio.t: Welcome to Domaine Lescure. We'll begin the tasting with our two lighter wines and finish with the reds. I should mention that our most expensive red comes from vines planted by my great-grandfather in 1921, and only two thousand bottles are produced each year. As for our less expensive red, it won a silver medal at the Lyon wine competition last spring. All wines are available in the shop at the end of the tour, and we offer free delivery on orders of twelve bottles or more.

questions.prompt: Where most likely is the talk taking place?
questions.evidence: Welcome to Domaine Lescure.
questions.explanation: Dégustation, vignes, boutique en fin de visite : on est dans un domaine viticole.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which wine won a medal?
questions.explanation: Le rouge le moins cher a reçu une médaille d'argent : parmi les rouges, c'est Vieilles Vignes (22 €).
questions.traps: Cuvée Héritage est le rouge le plus cher, issu des vignes de 1921.
questions.takeaway: « Less expensive red » : filtre d'abord par type, puis par prix.

questions.prompt: What is offered for large orders?
questions.evidence: we offer free delivery on orders of twelve bottles or more
questions.explanation: La livraison est gratuite à partir de douze bouteilles.

audio.t: Here's a traffic update for drivers in the western suburbs. Route 9 between Maple Avenue and the river bridge will be closed overnight from ten P.M. to five A.M. all week, while crews replace the street lights. During the closure, drivers should follow the detour signs through Oak Street. The work was originally planned for last month but was postponed because of the cycling race. City officials say the new lights will use sixty percent less electricity.

questions.prompt: Why will Route 9 be closed?
questions.evidence: while crews replace the street lights
questions.explanation: La route ferme la nuit pour remplacer l'éclairage public.
questions.traps: La course cycliste a seulement causé le report des travaux.

questions.prompt: What are drivers told to do?
questions.evidence: drivers should follow the detour signs through Oak Street
questions.explanation: Ils doivent suivre la déviation par Oak Street.

questions.prompt: What is mentioned about the new lights?
questions.evidence: will use sixty percent less electricity
questions.explanation: Les nouveaux éclairages consomment 60 % d'électricité en moins.

audio.t: Good morning. Today's session is about recognizing fraudulent e-mails. Last year, nearly forty percent of security incidents at companies our size started with a single click on a fake link. These messages often look like they come from a colleague or a supplier, and they usually create a sense of urgency. Now, I'm going to show you five real examples, with company names removed. For each one, I'd like you to find at least two warning signs. You'll work in pairs, and we'll discuss your answers in fifteen minutes.

questions.prompt: What is the session about?
questions.evidence: Today's session is about recognizing fraudulent e-mails.
questions.explanation: La séance porte sur la détection des e-mails frauduleux.

questions.prompt: According to the speaker, what do such messages often do?
questions.evidence: they usually create a sense of urgency
questions.explanation: Ces messages créent souvent un sentiment d'urgence.

questions.prompt: What will listeners do next?
questions.evidence: You'll work in pairs
questions.explanation: Ils vont analyser cinq exemples réels, par deux.

audio.t: Attention, all staff. The east parking lot will be closed starting Monday for resurfacing. The work is expected to take three weeks. During this time, staff may park in the visitors' garage on levels four and five only; the lower levels must remain available for patients. Your current parking badge will open the garage gate. I know the garage is a longer walk from the main building, so a shuttle will run every ten minutes during shift changes.

questions.prompt: Where are staff allowed to park during the work?
options: On the lower levels of a garage
On the upper levels of a garage
questions.evidence: staff may park in the visitors' garage on levels four and five only
questions.explanation: Le personnel doit utiliser les niveaux 4 et 5 du parking visiteurs.
questions.traps: Les niveaux inférieurs sont réservés aux patients.

questions.prompt: Why does the speaker say, "I know the garage is a longer walk from the main building"?
options: To introduce a solution to an inconvenience
To explain why the work is needed
questions.evidence: I know the garage is a longer walk from the main building
questions.explanation: Il reconnaît l'inconvénient avant d'annoncer la navette toutes les dix minutes.
questions.takeaway: « I know… so… » : inconvénient puis solution.

questions.prompt: What will staff use to enter the garage?
questions.evidence: Your current parking badge will open the garage gate.
questions.explanation: Le badge de parking actuel ouvre la barrière.

audio.t: As you know, we're replacing our packaging supplier. Our clients have made it clear that they want fully recycled packaging, so that's our first requirement. Second, because we ship fresh products, we can't wait more than a week for deliveries. Based on those two criteria, there's only one option, even though it isn't the cheapest. I'll ask the purchasing team to start negotiating with them tomorrow.

questions.prompt: What is the company's first requirement?
questions.evidence: they want fully recycled packaging, so that's our first requirement
questions.explanation: La première exigence est un emballage entièrement recyclé.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which supplier will the company most likely choose?
questions.explanation: 100 % recyclé et livraison en moins d'une semaine : seul EcoPack (100 %, 4 jours) répond aux deux critères. BoxLine est 100 % recyclé mais livre en 10 jours.
questions.takeaway: Applique les critères dans l'ordre donné.

questions.prompt: What will happen tomorrow?
questions.evidence: start negotiating with them tomorrow
questions.explanation: L'équipe achats commencera à négocier avec le fournisseur demain.

audio.t: Thank you all for coming to the opening of the new Eastside Library. This building used to be a textile factory, and the architects kept many of its original features, including the large windows and the iron columns you see around you. The library has twice as many computers as the old one, and a recording studio that residents can book for free. I'd especially like to thank the hundreds of volunteers who helped move more than eighty thousand books in just two weekends.

questions.prompt: What event is taking place?
questions.evidence: the opening of the new Eastside Library
questions.explanation: Il s'agit de l'inauguration de la nouvelle bibliothèque.

questions.prompt: What is mentioned about the building?
options: It was built last century as a school.
questions.evidence: This building used to be a textile factory
questions.explanation: Le bâtiment était autrefois une usine textile.

questions.prompt: Why does the speaker thank volunteers?
questions.evidence: helped move more than eighty thousand books
questions.explanation: Les bénévoles ont aidé à déménager plus de 80 000 livres.
